about: Pass/fail for the rig's runs (docs/leg-prototype-plan.md section 5, S1-S6; docs/leg-bench-tests.md). rig/compare.py applies them to a run's log. 'from_s'/'to_s' are seconds into the run; 'after' names the event a window starts at ('land': the controller's touchdown estimate, 'contact': the first wheel contact, 'cut': the power cut). A check with 'needs' is skipped when the run has no such signal (the load plate, the ToF).

reproduce.about: Task T7: the simulation backend running the rig's controller at the rig's rate reproduces exports/leg/rig-results.json (stand-up and squat peaks within 5 %, the jump height within 10 mm). The same configuration as the reference: 13.1 kg, an ideal 54 V bus, no measurement latency.

checks.what: holds 300 +- 10 mm
follows the prediction within 15 mm
peak motor torque <= 18 N m
no oscillation over 5 mm peak to peak in the hold
load plate 120-170 N steady (14.75 kg carried: about 145 N)
VBUS inside 32-45 V
follows the prediction within 15 mm (the model is right)
tracks the command within 35 mm (the VMC lags a 0.5 Hz squat by design: 26 mm predicted)

settles to 250 +- 15 mm within 0.5 s of landing
VBUS inside 28-45 V (a push sags it, the tuck and landing lift it)
motor torque feedback <= 55 N m
back to 300 +- 10 mm within 0.5 s of touching down
the dip within 20 % of the prediction
the fall's time within 30 % of the prediction rerun with B1's damping
